scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -k -n shadcn,app 'bun run --cwd ui/shadcn dev' 'bun run --cwd ui/web-app dev'
scripts.build: bun run --cwd ui/shadcn build && bun run --cwd ui/web-app build
scripts.test:browser: bun run test:browser:development && bun run test:browser:production
scripts.test:ui: bun run --cwd ui/shadcn test && bun run --cwd ui/web-app test
